query: I want to run an agent on a timer using my Claude Max plan, without paying for an API key. How?
expected_behavior: Uses the SDK headless path with claude setup-token to obtain CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
Warns to unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY because if it is present it wins and bills the API instead of the subscription
notes: Guards against silently billing the metered API. A lingering ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var overrides the OAuth subscription token, so the user pays per-token despite intending to use their Max plan.
